root.label: Kenya confirms first Ebola case after patient dies in Nairobi

events.label: Kenya confirms first Ebola case after patient dies in Nairobi

slots.name: quarantined family members
slots.sentence: Seeking to halt local transmission, Kenya’s President William Ruto said at least eight family members of the victim and 21 healthcare workers have been quarantined, as he ordered an enhanced response to contain the virus in the country.

slots.name: quarantined health workers
slots.sentence: Seeking to halt local transmission, Kenya’s President William Ruto said at least eight family members of the victim and 21 healthcare workers have been quarantined, as he ordered an enhanced response to contain the virus in the country.

slots.name: identified contacts
slots.sentence: Earlier, Health Secretary Duale said 28 contacts, including family members and health workers who cared for the patient, had been identified.

slots.name: passengers traced
slots.sentence: Another 23 passengers and four crew members who travelled on the same flight from Uganda were being traced.

slots.name: crew members traced
slots.sentence: Another 23 passengers and four crew members who travelled on the same flight from Uganda were being traced.

slots.name: duration of illness
slots.sentence: The patient, who had lived in the DRC for seven years, had been ill for about a month before travelling by road from the DRC to Uganda’s capital, Kampala, and then flying to Nairobi on Saturday, Aden Duale, Kenya’s health secretary, told a news conference on Tuesday.

slots.name: previous cases
slots.sentence: Kenya, a popular destination for travelers from the U.S., Asia and Europe, had until now dodged the deadly virus.
